string.text: Improved backplate
Replacing the standard butt plate with a softer one with improved shock absorption increases the ease of handling the gun.
Butt cutting
Without the buttstock, the gun weighs significantly less, increases maneuverability, but at the same time increases recoil.
Tritium insert
Installing a luminous insert in the sighting device allows you to increase the speed of aiming and the convenience of firing in the dark.
Trimming trunks
Significantly shortening the barrels reduces the weight of the gun, increases maneuverability and dispersion, but at the same time reduces the firing range and accuracy.
USM calibration
Individual fitting and balancing of standard parts of the firing mechanism allows for higher shooting accuracy while reducing recoil.
Modification of trunks
Thanks to complex modifications, the muzzle velocity of the bullet increases and the wear rate of the gun barrel decreases.
Lightweight handguard
Replacing a standard forend with a lightweight one allows you to slightly reduce the total weight of the weapon.
Titanium hinge
Replacing a standard hinge with a high-strength hinge can significantly increase the wear resistance of the gun barrel breaking mechanism.
Replacing triggers
Allows you to minimize the number of misfires due to insufficient pinning of the cartridge.
Balancing
A complex modification affecting almost all components of the gun.Has a beneficial effect on accuracy and impact.
Rifled barrel
Rifling the barrel can significantly improve shooting accuracy and increases the initial speed of the bullet, but makes it impossible to fire shotguns.
Protective coating
Applying a protective coating to barrels can significantly reduce the rate of wear, thereby extending the service life of the weapon.
